title: HTTP 204 No Content - Status Code Guide | Postman Blog
snippet: What is HTTP 204 No Content? The 204 No Content is an HTTP status code that indicates a request succeeded, but the server intentionally returns no message body. The server has successfully processed the requested resource and isn’t returning any content because there’s nothing meaningful to send back.
